info.title: QAgent API
info.description: Backend API for QAgent autonomous web application QA platform

get.description: Returns static array of all fixture events for testing.

Streams recorded QA run events over SSE.
Frontend Coder 2 connects to this to design real-time charts, telemetry, and step cards.

schema.description: Whether to loop the events indefinitely

get.description: Apps with last-run summary, pass rate over the last 20 runs, and open issue count.

schema.title: Response List App Runs Apps  App Id  Runs Get

post.description: Starts a run for an app: {playbook_id?, flow_keys?, include_edge_cases, mode}.
Claude proposes REQ- items from the app's PRD; each must be accepted by the user before it is saved.
Re-runs a finished run deterministically from its decision tape; `overrides` tweak gating and budgets.

get.description: SSE stream of run events. Resumes from `after` or the standard Last-Event-ID header.

post.description: Parses, validates and stores a Markdown playbook; unchanged content does not create a new version.
Parses and validates Markdown without saving it (drives the editor's inline errors and coverage panel).
Claude rewrites a freeform test description into canonical playbook Markdown (nothing is saved).

schema.title: Response List Versions Playbooks  Playbook Id  Versions Get
Response List Items Playbook Versions  Version Id  Items Get

get.description: Postgres is pinged for real; Jev, Bedrock and object storage report whether they are configured.
The evidence graph for one finding: screenshots, network calls, decisions, spans, trace, check inputs.
Current flows and edge-case variants with their last 10 results, median duration and flakiness.

schema.title: Response App Flows Apps  App Id  Flows Get
Response List Issues Apps  App Id  Issues Get

get.description: The latest bug report for the issue.

post.description: Rebuilds the run report and its bug reports from stored facts (narrative is regenerated too).

get.description: Markdown or HTML as stored; PDF is the HTML printed by Playwright (generated on first request).

Requirements -> the flows, formulas, UX rules and edge cases that cover them -> their latest check results
-> findings -> issues. Built from the stored item links and the most recent run of the version.
Serves e.g. steps/3/screenshot.jpg, steps/3/dom.html, network/{call}/response.json, trace.zip.
Shorthand for the first flow's screenshot; use the flow-qualified route when flows run in parallel.
A short-lived presigned URL (images, trace.zip, PDF); with local storage, the proxied content URL.
Proxied bytes (JSON, HTML, text): browsers cannot fetch() presigned URLs without bucket CORS rules.
